summary: The first profile-2 symbolic check timed out after 60 seconds when Quint ran in an isolated network namespace with loopback down while its Apalache endpoint was outside that namespace. The repaired launcher starts Quint and its server in one user/network namespace, raises only loopback through iproute2 before execution, and records host utility identities; the six declared invariants then passed under the stated six-step bound. This is an operational prerequisite, not a proof beyond the checked bounds.
title: Quint and Apalache require a shared isolated loopback
